# TimeIntervalStamp { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp }

```python
TimeIntervalStamp(start, end)
```

An interval defined by start and end TimeStamps.

Provides facilities for zipping corresponding (start, end) pairs
across all related timelines.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                  |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| start  | [TimeStamp](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.TimeStamp`) | TimeStamp at interval start. |
| end    | [TimeStamp](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.TimeStamp`) | TimeStamp at interval end.   |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> interval = timeline.get_interval_stamp(0.0, 10.0)
>>> interval.duration  # On axis timeline
10.0
>>> interval.get_interval("child:1")  # (start, end) tuple
(0.0, 7.5)
>>> interval.get_duration("child:1")
7.5
```

```python
>>> # Get all intervals at once
>>> interval.zip_intervals()
{'tl:1': (0.0, 10.0), 'child:1': (0.0, 7.5)}
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_coordinate_interval](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_coordinate_interval) | Get (start, end) as proper Coordinate objects. |

### get_coordinate_interval { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_coordinate_interval }

```python
TimeIntervalStamp.get_coordinate_interval(timeline_id)
```

Get (start, end) as proper Coordinate objects.

Unlike get_interval() which returns floats, this returns Coordinates
with the correct TimeUnit attached.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description                       | Default    |
|-------------|--------------|-----------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) | The timeline to get interval for. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                        | Description                                                  |
|--------|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'tuple\[Coordinate, Coordinate\] \| None\' | Tuple of (start, end) Coordinates, or None if not reachable. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> interval = timeline.get_interval_stamp(10.0, 50.0)
>>> start, end = interval.get_coordinate_interval("child:1")
>>> start.unit
<TimeUnit.seconds: 'seconds'>
```

### zip_intervals { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.zip_intervals }

```python

```

Get all (start, end) pairs across timelines.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                   | Description                                 | Default   |
|---------------|----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|-----------|
| timeline_ids  | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | Specific timelines to include (None = all). | `None`    |
| include_units | [list](`list`)\[\'TimeUnit\'\] \| None | C-Map units to include as well.             | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}
